subject: Lumera - request for tenant-specific 180d session-log retention evidence
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex@lumerahealth.com>

Cc: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@lumerahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumera request: 180d tenant session-log retention evidence for SOC 2 auditor

Hi Chloe,

We were asked by our SOC 2 auditor to provide (1) confirmation that Redwood can preserve tenant-scoped session/debug logs for 180 days, and (2) supporting evidence showing the retention, access controls, and proof-of-delete procedures you follow for those longer windows.

Specifically, auditor is looking for: a retention matrix (what objects are retained and for how long), a playbook for proof-of-delete / deletion certification, and any SIG/CAIQ supplemental artifacts demonstrating data segregation and KMS controls. Deadline for deliverables is EOD 2028-05-31.

We attached the auditor request for reference (SOC2_Audit_Request_2028.pdf). Can you confirm feasibility and what artifacts you can provide? Also flag any contractual steps required to enable 180d for our tenant.

Thanks,
Alex Monroe
Head of Security & Compliance
Lumera Health

--
Attachment: SOC2_Audit_Request_2028.pdf
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumera request: 180d tenant session-log retention evidence for SOC 2 auditor

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for the PDF. Looping in Ben (Infra/Runtime) and Marissa (CS / procurement) so we can put together a targeted evidence packet and surface any contractual changes.

Short answers up front: Redwood's default ephemeral session/debug traces retention is 90 days for hosted customers. We can support a customer-scoped 180-day retention in a scoped configuration, but it requires:

- A scoped config change tied to Lumera's tenant (not global)
- Encrypted-at-rest storage with tenant-specific KMS keys (we recommend a dedicated CMK)
- Narrowed access controls + separate audit logging for the longer-retention bucket

Ben — can you prepare a draft retention matrix and the technical proof-of-delete steps we would provide to auditors? Please indicate operational cost delta and any SLA impacts.

Marissa — can you advise on the contracting path (addendum / charge model) and whether we should offer a short free pilot while the legal redline is processed?

Target internal deliverables I aim to share with Lumera by 2028-05-26: retention-matrix-lumera.xlsx, proof-of-delete-procedure.md, and a SIG/CAIQ supplemental excerpt.

Alex — can you also confirm the HubSpot deal id so we can track this in our compliance response?

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Lumera request: 180d tenant session-log retention evidence for SOC 2 auditor

Chloe / team — quick technical note and what I'll include in the artifacts.

Feasibility: We can enable a tenant-scoped 180d retention for session and debug traces. Two implementation patterns:

1) Scoped extended retention: store Lumera logs in a separate encrypted bucket with a Lumera CMK and apply retention policy for 180d. Access via RBAC group with elevated audit hooks.
2) Escrow + on-demand export: keep standard 90d hot store + nightly secure escrow snapshot stored for 180d; access by request for audits.

I recommend option 1 (separate bucket + CMK) for auditor comfort; option 2 is lower cost but requires retrieval workflow.

Artifacts I'm attaching/drafting: retention-matrix-lumera.xlsx (matrix of objects + retention), proof-of-delete-procedure.md (walkthrough + logs that show deletes are enforced and validated), and a short SIG supplement (we will pull encrypt/segregation sections). I'll include a brief cost estimate (expected ~12-18% storage + ops uplift for 180d vs 90d under your throughput).

Quoting Alexs ask below for context:
> We were asked by our SOC 2 auditor to provide (1) confirmation that Redwood can preserve tenant-scoped session/debug logs for 180 days, and (2) supporting evidence showing the retention, access controls, and proof-of-delete procedures you follow for those longer windows.

I'll have draft artifacts ready by COB 2028-05-25 for Chloe/Marissa to review.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the patience. Attaching the draft artifacts we discussed and summarizing next steps below. (I've redacted internal pointers in this thread; public artifacts are the attachments and Drive links.)

What we can provide today:
- retention-matrix-lumera.xlsx — matrix mapping session/debug traces, audit logs, and derived indexes to a 180-day retention window.
- proof-of-delete-procedure.md — step-by-step deletion workflow, automated verification job output, and hash-based tombstone sample for auditors.
- sig-supplemental-evidence.pdf — excerpted SIG/CAIQ controls showing tenant isolation and KMS usage.

Summary & commercial path: Redwood can enable tenant-scoped 180d retention for Lumera. To proceed we need a short addendum that (a) authorizes the tenant-specific config change and (b) includes a modest monthly storage/ops premium; Marissa will follow up with a draft addendum and DocuSign link. We are also willing to enable a 30-day pilot at no charge so your auditor can review artifacts in situ while the addendum is finalized.

- HubSpot: HS-71234 (added tags: SOC2, retention-request)

Next steps for Lumera: please confirm you want the pilot enabled (30 days) and confirm HubSpot deal id so Marissa can route the addendum. If everything looks good, we can have the pilot live within 48 hours of confirmation.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute call if your auditor wants direct access to artifacts.

Best,
